features.title: DreamingRAG memory adapter prototype
features.behavior: By default, Tutor attempts to retrieve long-term memory snippets from a narrow DreamingRAG adapter before generation and records the user/assistant turn after generation, while unavailable DreamingRAG dependencies gracefully fall back to null memory.
